0.question: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
0.answer: Yes. But you don't need to be an expert. We take care of the technical part and always make sure our clients understand how things work. Also, we offer training so your team can be self-sufficient and not depend on us for everything.

1.question: How long does it take to be ready?
1.answer: It depends on the project, but most automations are operational within 2 to 4 weeks. We work in sprints so you see results quickly, using agile development methodologies.

2.question: What happens if the automation fails or I need to make changes?
2.answer: Ordinaly offers additional and optional technical support to maintain and update your systems. We also offer training so your team can be capable of making changes by themselves.

3.question: Why is Ordinaly different?
3.answer: We don't use generic templates or standard solutions. Each automation is designed from scratch adapted to your business, and you can always call us, visit us, or meet with us when you need. We believe in personal and personalized treatment, and in the transparency of our processes. Additionally, we are specialists in SMEs and work with free and open-source software (FLOSS) and European.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about our courses and training
faq.subtitle: We solve all your doubts before you sign up for a course at Ordinaly

0.q: Do I need previous programming knowledge?
0.a: No. Our workshops are designed for entrepreneurs, freelancers and teams of any profile. It is not necessary to have programming knowledge or previous experience in automation or artificial intelligence. We offer courses for all levels, from beginners to advanced, and we adapt the content according to the group of attendees.

1.q: What do I need to bring (laptop, email account, etc.)?
1.a: For in-person workshops you need to bring your own laptop (with charger) and an active email account, such as Gmail, to follow the exercises in real-time. If a workshop requires something additional, we will notify you by email a few days in advance.

2.q: Do you issue any certificates or diplomas upon completion?
2.a: Yes, all participants who complete the workshop receive a participation certificate from Ordinaly, useful for accrediting the training with your company or for your resume.

3.q: What happens if I sign up and can't attend? Can I cancel or change the date?
3.a: You can cancel your enrollment without cost from your profile on our website up to 24 hours before the start of the workshop, freeing your spot for another person. If you need to change the date, please contact us and we will help you move to the next edition according to availability.

4.q: Can I request a customized training for my industry?
4.a: Yes. In addition to our open courses, we design customized training programs for specific teams and sectors (real estate, marketing agencies, clinics, property management companies, etc.), with content and use cases adapted to your business.

enrollment.bonificationInfo:
Some of our trainings may be subsidized via FUNDAE/SEPE and/or fit into co-funded calls by FSE+ and PRTR-NextGenerationEU, provided your company meets requirements and processes the aid.

FUNDAE / SEPE - Company-funded training: allows part of the training cost to be offset in Social Security contributions. Official info for companies (FUNDAE) and training for employees (SEPE).

EU Funds - FSE+ 2021-2027: national and regional programs (including Andalusia) financing employment, education, and training through public calls. See UAFSE.

PRTR - NextGenerationEU (Component 23): measures for upskilling and active employment policies; coverage depends on each call. Official info from the Recovery Plan and SEPE.

Andalusia (regional scope): FSE+ Andalusia 2021-2027 and Vocational Training for Employment (FPE) publish specific grants/calls. See Junta de Andalucía and FPE.

Notice: Eligibility, intensity, and compatibility vary by regulation and current calls. Ordinaly provides course documentation but does not apply for or process subsidies on the client's behalf. Always review official links before contracting.

bonificationTexts.summary: Some of our training may be subsidized via FUNDAE/SEPE or fit into calls co-financed by FSE+ and PRTR-NextGenerationEU, provided your company meets requirements and processes the aid independently.
bonificationTexts.details:
**FUNDAE / SEPE - Company-sponsored training:** allows part of the training cost to be subsidized through Social Security contributions. Official info for Companies ([FUNDAE](https://www.fundae.es/empresas)) and Training for employees ([SEPE](https://www.sepe.es/HomeSepe/empresas/informacion-para-empresas/formacion-para-ocupados.html)).

**EU Funds - FSE+ 2021-2027:** national and regional programs (including Andalusia) that finance employment, education, and training actions through public calls. See [UAFSE](https://www.mites.gob.es/UAFSE/es/FSE21_27/programas/index.htm).

**PRTR - NextGenerationEU (Component 23):** measures for training and active employment policies; coverage depends on each call. Official info from the [Recovery Plan](https://planderecuperacion.gob.es/politicas_y_componentes/componente-23-nuevas-politicas-publicas-para-un-mercado-de-trabajo-dinamico-resiliente-e-inclusivo) and [SEPE](https://www.sepe.es/HomeSepe/empresas/informacion-para-empresas/formacion-para-ocupados.html).

**Andalusia (regional):** FSE+ Andalusia 2021-2027 and Vocational Training for Employment (FPE) publish specific grants/calls. See [Junta de Andalucía](https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/organismos/economiahaciendayfondoseuropeos/areas/fondos-europeos-andalucia/normativa-programacion/programacion/programacion-2021-2027/paginas/europeos-social-2021-2027.html) and [FPE](https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/temas/trabajar/formacion/fpe.html).

**Notice:** Eligibility, intensity, and compatibility of funding vary by regulations and current calls. Ordinaly provides course documentation but does not apply for or process subsidies or grants on behalf of the client. Always check official links before contracting.

about.whatAnswer: Ordinaly Software S.L. is a Seville-based business automation company that uses AI (when it's actually needed) to design, build, and deploy chatbots and workflows for SMBs and corporate teams.
about.goalQuestion: What do we want to achieve?
about.goalAnswer: Our mission is to empower people's work with new technologies, rather than replace them. We want businesses that use our automations to have time to focus on creativity, decisions, and relationships — the things a machine shouldn't do. We want our clients to feel comfortable and secure with our systems, which is why we place real importance on keeping them transparent and simple for any company.

implantacion-odoo.title: Odoo Implementation
implantacion-odoo.heroText: Ordinaly's Odoo 18 implementation and upgrade service is aimed at businesses and SMEs in Spain that need a platform to organize their company and the way they work.

sectionTitles.technologyFaqsSubtitle: Here we answer the most common questions.

paragraphs: Odoo is one of the best-selling and most widely used ERPs in the world, with millions of active users and growing adoption thanks to its flexibility, scalability and wide ecosystem of modules for business management, sales, accounting, CRM and operations.
whatIsOdoo.linkPrefix: You can find out more about Odoo on its official website:

paragraphs: Odoo combines CRM, accounting, invoicing, inventory, sales and many more modules into a single platform, with a modern interface and a much shorter learning curve than traditional ERPs.
Its modular structure lets you start with the essentials and grow without switching systems, adapting to your business's real pace instead of forcing you into a rigid process.

We implement Odoo Community, Odoo's free, open-source edition. It's just as maintainable, secure and functional as the Enterprise edition, but far more cost-effective since it avoids the recurring cost of per-user licenses.
And you're not relying solely on Ordinaly either: Odoo Community is backed by a large community of developers and companies that continuously publish modules, improvements and fixes.

technologyFaqs.answer: We implement Odoo Community, Odoo's free, open-source edition. Since it doesn't depend on Odoo Enterprise's per-user licenses, the cost is limited to the implementation service: a one-time payment, with no recurring monthly per-user fees.

technologyFaqs.answer: The system is deployed on infrastructure you control (your own server or a VPS). You keep full control of your data and access, and we don't retain credentials or copies of your information after the service is delivered.

technologyFaqs.question: Why do you implement Odoo Community instead of Odoo Enterprise?
technologyFaqs.answer: Odoo Community is just as maintainable, secure and functional as the Enterprise edition, but far more cost-effective long-term since it avoids the recurring cost of per-user licenses. And you're not relying solely on Ordinaly either: Odoo Community is backed by a large community of developers and companies.

technologyFaqs.answer: Odoo Community is backed by a large global community of developers and companies that continuously publish modules, fixes and improvements.
technologyFaqs.answerEmphasis: Ordinaly handles the implementation, configuration and direct technical maintenance for your business.

technologyFaqs.question: Can you migrate my business from another ERP or from Odoo Enterprise?
technologyFaqs.answer: Yes. We analyze your current system, define the functional scope needed and migrate your data and processes to Odoo Community without losing operational continuity.
